items.insight: Club VanderBlog: Raiders 22-20 at Reliant Thursday night. Houston led 7-0 then 20-3; Woody Marks 37 yards and a 20-yard TD on the opening drive; Wade Woodaz pick-6. One more joint practice and one more preseason game remain — at Carolina Friday, Aug. 28, 6 p.m. CT. A preseason box score is not the 53. Opener still Sept. 13 vs. Buffalo.
